name: io.github.zp130221/pdfedit-mcp
description: Edit text inside existing PDFs: replace, delete, redact, insert, fill forms; original fonts kept.

environmentVariables.name: PDFEDIT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the PDF Edit API. Without one the server can still reach a gateway you run yourself; the hosted endpoint has a keyless free tier.

environmentVariables.name: PDFEDIT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:8000; set it to the hosted API or to your own deployment.
